launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Juliet, Austin, Michael, and Michael. We’re the team behind [Procoto](https://procoto.com/). We’re on a mission to make procurement software more accessible and affordable for everyone.\
\
**tl;dr:** Procoto makes running RFPs, tracking contracts, and managing vendors simple and affordable. We get procurement teams out of dense systems and spreadsheets without having to drop a hefty check on SAP or Coupa.

And it’s self-service! No sales calls, redlines, or lengthy implementations. Snag our [YC launch offer](https://app.procoto.com/register?ref=yc) to get started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/ab363823-cd33-4b41-9d5e-05867dcf4d98)

### **😤 The problem with procurement software**

Small and mid-market companies face the same sourcing, contract, vendor, and spend management challenges of larger organizations, but with fewer resources and without the funds for an enterprise procurement platform.

* RFPs are conducted with spreadsheets and emails
* Time is wasted searching for, selecting, and inviting vendors to bid
* Contract terms, vendor information, and spend data are spread across systems
* Person hours are dedicated to data management rather than securing better rates
* Historical bidding and pricing disappear after the RFP
* The alternative solution today is a six-figure annual agreement with one of the big boys

### **😇 How we’re fixing it**

Procoto eschews (bless you) the complexity and the feature bloat of enterprise procurement software. We keep it simple and user-friendly in a tool built for everyone. Procoto automates the collection of RFP, contract, and vendor information into a centralized system and highlights savings opportunities based on historical data.

<https://youtu.be/1FCv2I6Ywho>

### 😍 **Community fav features**

### **🤡 Why us?**

We built procurement organizations at a couple of startups and have used 30+ of our competitors’ software. We lived the pain we’re solving for years and finally left to build the solution we couldn’t find Something self-service, customizable, with UI/UX from this decade, and built for users without supply chain degrees.

### **🙏🏻 Our ask**

* Give Procoto a whirl if you run RFPs, sign contracts, or work with third-party vendors
* We’d love to talk to and learn from anyone in the procurement world, especially those in multi-site businesses:
  * Franchises

  * Apartment groups
  * PEs that manage any of the above

### **👀 The YC Deal**

* 30-day trial
* Complimentary vendor and contract data cleanup
* 40% off your first year if you go monthly ($59/mo)
* 50% off your first year if you go annual ($479/yr)
* [Redeem here](https://app.procoto.com/register?ref=yc)

If you’d like to learn more or have questions, shoot us an email at [michael@procoto.com](mailto:michael@procoto.com)!

launches.title: Care Weather 🌎 🛰️ Highest-accuracy global weather data from low-cost satellites
launches.tagline: We help weather-sensitive organizations adapt to increasingly extreme weather.
launches.body:
Hi everyone! We’re [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-laraway-8ba461169/) and [Patrick](http://linkedin.com/in/mpatrickwalton) from [Care Weather](https://www.careweather.com/). We’re leveraging SpaceX rideshare and 5G electronics to make a swarm of low-cost satellites that get 17X more accurate global weather data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79524&key=user_uploads/349337/502dc652-58a2-489c-928c-3cedb21358be)

_(Left) Alex with with a flight-ready satellite. (Right) Patrick testing the latest satellite._

### [🌪️](https://emojipedia.org/tornado) **Problem**

Weather is quietly [costing billions](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/billions/) across the economy. For example:

* ✈️ A recent supertyphoon damaged $200M of Air Force planes in Guam ([JTWC](https://www.metoc.navy.mil/jtwc/products/atcr/2018atcr.pdf)).
* 🚢 Ocean cargo ships reroute around so many unpredicted cyclones that they lose $60M of voyage time per ship per year.

It may seem like your weather app has tons of data to prevent this, but weather apps pretend predicted data is real. Those predictions are based on limited, inaccurate measurements from aging government satellites. Other solutions (weather stations, balloons, drones) aren’t scalable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79524&key=user_uploads/349337/5ce389df-7421-4592-aa8c-dc75b9ba0e7b)

### **🌎 🛰️ Solution**

After studying with a NASA expert, we invented a modernized radar satellite, called [Veery](https://careweather.com/tech). We can mass produce Veery at low cost and get orders of magnitude more truth data. Veery’s flat form factor gives it way more solar power and lets it sail on top of the atmosphere for a closer view of the surface. Veery will map ocean surface vector winds, soil moisture, and sea ice globally, every hour, with 100 m - 6 km resolution.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79524&key=user_uploads/349337/fe836808-1163-4870-b7d1-7849bbbadb47)

### **🚀 Traction**

In the last four months, we built and launched the smallest radar satellite in history! And we did it with pre-seed funding and a team of two. In the same timeframe, we received $50M worth of LOIs from the Air Force, the National Weather Service, and several maritime companies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79524&key=user_uploads/349337/563a1d03-1716-4c5d-a467-4ad4ff993d97)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79524&key=user_uploads/349337/20167ab2-c237-4521-995e-2b2b114502c8)

### **Asks**

Help us build a disaster-free future!

* Follow us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/CareWeather) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/careweather/).
* If you work with weather data or in a weather-sensitive business, [sign up for our waitlist](https://careweather.com/waitlist)! We’ll have pilot data this Fall.

launches.title: Popl - Make Conferences & Events Your Best GTM Channel
launches.tagline: Imagine one AI-powered lead capture platform that finally makes your events worth it.
launches.body:
# ⚡️ **TLDR**

[Popl](https://hubs.ly/Q03RBCTQ0) is the universal lead capture platform for in-person events. Scan any event badge, business card, or QR code, instantly enrich the lead with accurate data, and sync it into your CRM with full attribution. Events have been stuck with outdated tools for too long. We’re bringing AI-powered enrichment and modern technology to a world ready for disruption.

\
Hey everyone! 👋\
\
I’m [Jason](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasonalco/), co-founder & CEO at [Popl](https://hubs.ly/Q03RBCTQ0). We’re building the **universal lead capture and enrichment platform for in-person events** — helping companies instantly turn real-world conversations into measurable sales pipeline.

# 🔥 **The Problem**

Companies (and startups, see data below!) spend **$20K–$1M+** per booth at conferences.

They send their best reps and team members. They fly the team out, book hotels, pay for meals, etc. They invest in beautiful booths and marketing.

But when it comes to capturing leads, most still rely on:

* Clunky badge scanner apps that barely work
* Writing info down in Apple notes or collecting LinkedIns
* CSVs from event organizer delivered _weeks_ after the event
* No CRM integrations meaning slow speed to lead/follow-ups

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95162&key=user_uploads/479381/85854025-5908-4824-bf0e-80d2b029de7f)

The result?

**Slow follow-ups (leading to your competitors winning more), lost leads, and lower ROI on events.**

What if there was a platform that solved all of this, that GTM teams could set up once and then use across every single event…

# 🚀 **Our Solution**

Popl provides your company with a unified in-person GTM platform that:

* Scans any event badge, business card, or LinkedIn QR with the same app every time.
* Enriches each scan with accurate contact + company data (work email, phone numbers, LinkedIn, company revenue, tech stack, HQ location, etc.)
* Allows you to add context like notes, qualifying questions, and tags to each lead.
* Syncs it automatically to your CRM in seconds — HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Zoho, Dynamics, Monday, Slack, etc all natively supported.
* Manage everything through event campaigns which also show leaderboards, pipeline generated, and ROI.

**All while your team members stay focused on their conversations, not the tools. Plus no more waiting for CSV uploads, manual data entry, or other post-event headaches.**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HVAza1f74MU

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95162&key=user_uploads/479381/4c32029c-d3b5-4bc1-8740-f89166adf1e4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95162&key=user_uploads/479381/2eec6c29-0795-4dbe-bca9-354b185f75b6)

# **🤔 Is This For Us?**

Now some might assume events are only for big, legacy companies and not for startups or mid-market companies. But here’s what we’re seeing:

1️⃣ With AI flooding channels like cold email and cold calling, in-person GTM is surging. People still want to buy from people (and especially not from AI), and when digital outreach feels saturated and impersonal, meeting potential buyers face-to-face gives you a real edge.

2️⃣ The GTM data on startup companies shared by [@Richard Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zrlee/) showed a hidden insight that “Attending conferences” is the 3rd most popular growth strategy for YC startups. This shows events are not just a nice-to-have, they are a core growth lever.

3️⃣ We’re already seeing modern, fast-growing companies adopt Popl — like Square, Hammerspace, MavenAGI, Turing, Vercel, and Wiz. Events aren’t just for legacy enterprises; they’re becoming a key channel for the next generation of breakout startups.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95162&key=user_uploads/479381/58dc8dbf-aec3-4f44-b902-15d055feeecd)

# 🤝 **Next Steps**

If you want to get started with Popl, or are interested in learning more, book a demo with us here:[ ](https://popl.co/pages/request-a-demo)[**Book a Demo**](https://hubs.ly/Q03RBCTQ0)

We especially love providing value to the YC community, so let us know on your demo that you came from this Launch YC post and we’ll give you a significant discount!

**THANK YOU! 🚀**

launches.tagline: Send us your UGC ad and get back a TV & Desktop ready version within days.
launches.body:
Today on [Outpaint](https://outpaint.com/ad-reframe) we are launching **Ad Reframe**, the easiest way for advertisers to convert their winning UGC (9:16) for connected TV (16:9). <https://outpaint.com/ad-reframe>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/0d9469eb-a8fe-4035-82b5-8b8101014f76)

**The problem**

Advertisers test endlessly to find a winning UGC video, then want to squeeze every bit of value from it, including running it on TV. But converting vertical to horizontal for the big screen today means black bars from pillarboxing or a smeared side blur.

**The solution**

Instead of adding black bars, we expand the content so it looks like it was shot natively for TV.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/9c2c0fed-b0bb-4904-a4f4-55b28373782d)

Outpainting wins on everything advertisers measure: engagement (skip rate falls to 17%, the lowest tested), quality (55% say it looks professionally produced vs. under 40% for the alternatives), and brand lift (consideration at 51%, favorability at 58%), because filling the screen with real content beats hiding the gap behind bars or blur. Report [link](https://outpaint.com/case-studies/ctv-format-test)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/79d0f1d7-f541-4f01-9255-c811dde479f9)

**How it works**

The conversion generates new content where the black bars used to be. We support any aspect ratio, resolutions up to 8K, any frame rate, and any color space.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103954&key=user_uploads/579262/b9f35bc8-49fc-4b12-ac11-e2cb85002956)

Have an ad you want to convert? Grab 15 minutes on my calendar and we'll set you up. <https://cal.com/daniel-habib/15min>

People consume video on many different devices, but video can only be shot for a single screen at a time.

**Solution**

Our models expand any video to fit any screen by generating content to fill the extra space, while preserving every pixel of the original video.

**Examples**

9:16 →16:9 (Ads and Micro-dramas)

Hey everyone,

I’m Dan, and I’m super excited to share that we are starting to roll out QuickVid [**Autopilot**](https://www.quickvid.ai/autopilot)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/891b19bb-7b43-492c-b234-ee213cd4a28b)

### The Problem

Consistently posting clips to your socials is just too time-consuming and expensive.

🕗 Time Intensive: Curating and editing a 40-second clip from a 30-minute video can take up to 1-2 hours.

💰 Expensive: A decent video editor can cost upwards of $200/clip

🖥️ Difficult to get started: Editing requires specialized software like Adobe Premiere

😰 You are too busy: Consistently posting to your socials is something that busy founders just don’t have time for!

📊 Trends are always changing: What works on each social channel is always changing. We stay on top of trends, so you don’t have to.

### The Solution

Connect Autopilot to your long videos and desired posting locations, and you’re done! Autopilot will find the best clip from all your video sources and post it on your behalf every day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/a608e70e-d60d-4a25-98f6-97912f52d317)

**Connect your video source**

These are the locations QuickVid will pull clips from. QuickVid checks for new content daily. (YouTube, Drive, Zoom, etc.)

**Connect your video destinations**

This is where Autopilot will post your clips every day (YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, etc)

**Choose your cadence**

Either post once per day or let our AI decide the best time and cadence to post

### About the Clips

Clips are:

* Automatically cropped to a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio
* Auto-Reframed to focus on the speaker
* Baked with captions to help keep a viewer’s attention
* Personalized with your branding

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81306&key=user_uploads/579262/27645561-3a5a-4e38-af3a-0445c2ea712a)

### Who is Autopilot for?

If you consistently create long **_talking_** videos (podcasts, interviews, zoom meetings, etc.) and are struggling to keep up with posting clips, sign up for Autopilot, and I will personally onboard you!

**TL;DR**\
FirstSupport grants superpowers to customer support teams by automating translation, information retrieval, generating brand-aligned responses, summarizing conversations, generating insightful reports, and automating tagging.\
\
One week following our launch on Zendesk Marketplace, our product has been used by e-commerce merchants using platforms like _Magento/Woocommerce/Shopify_, customer support outsourcing firms, and startups across Asia, Europe, and America. These companies serve customers from multiple countries who speak different languages, and they manage extensive knowledge bases.\
—

---

1- **Instant Response Drafting**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76629&key=user_uploads/376547/c2baeb66-ae16-4028-91bf-26aa6171e6cd)

Whenever your customer support team opens a ticket, FirstSupport AI will automatically generate a response draft based on

* Information on your knowledge resource (Zendesk Knowledge Base, Google Docs, PDF, Website, Sitemap, Past Ticket Conversations, and more) that you can connect in our dashboard
* Information from the connected third-party platform (Shopify/Stripe/Woocommerce), or custom APIs such as your internal tool
* Brand personality guideline for your company

So you can review and submit directly in one click. See how it works:

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=76629&key=user_uploads/376547/47643cc9-4c86-4d61-a2e9-11dcf6c97122)

* Automatically detect the customer's language and translate the entire conversation into your preferred language

See it in action:

FirstSupport AI analyzes each customer interaction and support ticket to identify common issues, knowledge gaps, and immediate action steps. Additionally, you'll receive an email summary with detailed highlights attached.

You can try our product by registering on our [web app](https://app.firstsupport.ai), or by installing it from [Zendesk Marketplace](https://www.zendesk.com/marketplace/apps/support/980970/firstsupport-ai-assistant/).\

name: Greywing
long_description:
Greywing is a platform for ship operators to automate their business, through actionable intelligence, better data and communication.

Greywing today serves three product lines to customers:

*Flotilla* is a monitoring tool for vessels, enabling vessel managers to identify fleet-level patterns and optimizations and to identify risk and liability vectors in advance.

*CRY4* is an operational tool for individual vessels that allows crew managers, security officers and masters to gather intelligence about a vessels current or proposed route, making decisions about the safest and the cheapest ports of call that a vessel can be directed to.

*Landfall* is a crew management and analysis system to provide risk reporting and detailed editing capabilities about the crew on-board a vessel.

*Semaphore* is a port-agent communications tool meant to simplify the process of interfacing with large numbers of port agents while planning a port call.
one_liner: The Operating System for Maritime

long_description:
Auricle is a medical device company building a breakthrough neurostimulation implant to restore hearing in millions of patients who no longer benefit from hearing aids, get less than 60% on a word recognition test, but aren't prepared to make the jump to a cochlear implant. 

Our approach preserves remaining natural hearing through a reversible and less invasive surgery, addressing the key concerns that hold most patients back from getting a cochlear implant (currently the only treatment option for these patients).

The company spun out of Stanford Biodesign having completed two acute human clinical studies demonstrating the approach will work. The team is now focused on developing their full implant system for their first clinical trial. 

Auricle addresses a currently unserved profile of hearing loss that affects a growing population of 3.5 million patients in the US and represents an immediately accessible $1.2B market opportunity with existing reimbursement.

launches.title: LightTwist - Record and stream in a realistic virtual studio, even if your guests and co-hosts are remote
launches.tagline: A virtual video studio that runs in Chrome
launches.body:
Hi friends! Vikas here from LightTwist, excited to share our new launch!

**Check out our 45 second launch video here**:[ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYGvhRrOXBI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYGvhRrOXBI)

**TL;DR:** LightTwist lets you record and stream in a realistic virtual studio, even if your guests and co-hosts are remote.

**The problem**: Your video/podcast/webinar looks like a boring Zoom call. If you want to upgrade to something that looks like a real show you need to build out a physical video studio and bring people into it.

**The solution:** LightTwist is a virtual video studio that runs in Chrome - all the heavy compute is done in the cloud using realtime computer vision, Unreal Engine 5, and WebRTC. This means you can record and stream your show, product announcement, or webinar in a realistic virtual studio, even if your guests and co-hosts are remote.

**We’re launching publicly next week, July 1 at 9 am PT but wanted to give early access to YC!**

**Launch YC special offer 1 (up to 10 spots) - Buy a Show!** Purchase [here](https://buy.stripe.com/9B6aEY7YX0Iv0Bo6Xz5c40b)

* We’ll record and produce your WWDC style product announcement or podcast/YouTube show episode for $500.
* Includes customized virtual studio with your branding and 2 months of LightTwist Studio.
* We’re experimenting with a full service product which is why we’re offering this on Launch YC!

**YC special offer 2 - 90% off LightTwist for 2 months!** Sign up [here](https://studio.lighttwist.com/onboarding/9996d28e-75a0-476b-ad7b-621d43200f95) (use promo code **LAUNCHYC2026**)

* You can sign up, pick from a studio template and start recording or streaming.
* I’ll personally help you get your studio set up! I’ll email you after you sign up to set up a time

**Ask:** If there’s a creator or company you think would be a great fit, please let me know or have them email me at [vikas@lighttwist.com](mailto:vikas@lighttwist.com) !

**How we got here:**

I started LightTwist in 2021 after seeing how Industrial Light and Magic built a huge 360 surround stage for the Mandalorian show where they had a tracked camera and rendered the scene in realtime using Unreal Engine.

I’ve started a few computer vision companies (RedLaser, a barcode scanning price comparison app -[acquired by eBay](https://www.wsj.com/articles/BL-DGB-15645), [Twindo.com](http://Twindo.com) - FKA Occipital), so I thought there had to be a way to make virtual production much more accessible using computer vision and software engineering.

We’ve gone through several iterations, started as an iOS app for filmmakers, built a macOS app to be an awesome virtual camera for Zoom/etc, but have gotten a lot more traction once we positioned LightTwist as a virtual video studio and rebuilt it to run in the cloud.

We’ve signed an enterprise customer using LightTwist to power their video streaming platform (not yet announced!), and we’ve been iterating with other creators and studios including building a gameshow for Jimmy Fallon’s video production company.

We’re excited to be rolling this out publicly!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104358&key=user_uploads/553876/8b670e29-4613-40a1-bfca-92be5d46d938)

**Launch video here**: [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYGvhRrOXBI**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYGvhRrOXBI)

launches.title: OpenNext — Deploy Next.js apps to AWS
launches.tagline: OpenNext lets you deploy a Next.js app to your AWS account with just 3 commands.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** _OpenNext is an open-source serverless adapter for Next.js. You can use it to deploy Next.js 13 apps to your AWS account._

Hi all! Today we are launching OpenNext — [https://open-next.js.org](https://open-next.js.org/). An open-source serverless adapter for Next.js. It allows you to deploy Next.js apps _serverlessly_ outside of Vercel.

(We created a silly video to celebrate the launch 🤪)

<https://youtu.be/k_8lBdPC3gk>

### Problem

Even though Next.js is designed to run in a serverless environment and does on Vercel; they make it really hard to self-host Next.js with serverless. It requires you to reverse engineer how Vercel does things internally. There have been many attempts to fix this. But most of these projects have either failed or have ended up as closed source paid services that are often buggy. [Learn more about the problem](https://open-next.js.org/).

### How it works

So we decided to bring the community together and build an open-source serverless adapter for Next.js.

OpenNext works by running `next build` and transforming the output to a format that can be deployed to AWS. [Learn more about how it works](https://github.com/serverless-stack/open-next#how-does-opennext-work).

### Get started

OpenNext generates an output that is framework agnostic but the easiest way to use it is with [SST](https://sst.dev/).

* `npx create-next-app`
* `npx create-sst`
* `npx sst deploy`

Check out our tutorial to get started — [**https://docs.sst.dev/start/nextjs**](https://docs.sst.dev/start/nextjs) and join us on Discord if you have any questions — <https://discord.gg/sst>

name: Codingal
long_description:
Codingal (www.codingal.com) is the global leader in online AI and coding education for kids and teens (Grades 1-12). Our mission is to help students fall in love with AI & coding and become creators of the future - entrepreneurs, engineers, and scientists by providing high-quality, accessible, and personalized computer science education.

In many countries, top technical universities exist, but there’s a significant gap in K-12 programming education. Parents want their kids to start learning programming early, and that’s why they choose Codingal. We offer live, interactive classes with expert instructors from Computer Science backgrounds. All our instructors are rigorously vetted and trained to ensure a high-quality learning experience.

Every student receives a personalized learning path tailored to their age and skill level. Our curriculum is STEM.org-accredited, aligned with the K–12 Computer Science Framework, and delivered in 1:1 and small-group formats, ensuring individual attention and engagement.

Students learn by building real-world projects using popular tools and technologies like Scratch, Python, Roblox, Minecraft, MIT App Inventor, Thunkable, Pygame, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, website development, Java, Data Science, AP Computer Science content, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Machine Learning frameworks. Through this hands-on approach, students create apps, games, animations, and websites in a fun, engaging way that fosters problem-solving and creative skills.

Beyond classes, students participate in global coding competitions, hackathons like HPE CodeWars, and online coding camps, further nurturing their creativity, confidence, and innovative spirit. With a 4.9/5 student rating and NPS of 86, Codingal is trusted by over 1 million registered students in 70+ countries.

Codingal combines the best of human instruction and AI-driven learning to inspire the next generation of tech leaders. We are poised to lead the next generation of coding education and make a significant impact in this rapidly growing market.
one_liner: Leading online after-school for kids & teens to learn AI & coding

Platypus is a toolkit to help data engineers and technical founders manage their distributed and real-time data 10x faster. We help you organize and connect any data, across any stack, in any format. Fast.

### **The Problem**
Managing distributed data is tough and costly in an ever-evolving landscape where the concept of a "modern" data stack is rapidly aging, requiring **expert teams, multiple tools, and expensive resources**. On top of that, the Business teams **struggle to access** and use this data effectively.

### **The Solution**
**A** **customizable,** **real-time** **data platform that** **boosts data engineering productivity**. We simplify data with automation for data discovery, data management, and data pipeline creation while keeping data engineers in full control of their data architecture. We also allow business teams to self-serve the data and data activation they need.

### **Any Data, Any Stack, Any Client.**

launches.title: Striga - Crypto-backed card issuing APIs
launches.tagline: Flexible APIs to issue Virtual/Physical Visa Cards backed by Bitcoin, USDT etc.
launches.body:
Striga offers powerful (and compliant!) APIs to issue and manage a crypto card program, enabling builders to embed compliant real-time spending workflows for authorizing card transactions against a crypto balance.

**Why Striga?**

In today’s climate, setting up a simple custody or exchange business, let alone a card program either costs several millions + years of your time in jumping through regulatory hoops and approvals, or is simply denied by financial institutions.

[Striga is the first company licensed](https://striga.com/blog/the-first-vasp-licensed-under-estonia-aml-framework/) under a regime very similar to the proposed [MiCA](https://www.klgates.com/MiCA-Overview-of-the-new-EU-crypto-asset-regulatory-framework-Part-1-11-15-2022) legislation, taking care of all the heavy lifting under the hood (banking connectors, liquidity, custodian connectors, issuing, processing, compliance, monitoring, reporting) and **exposing simple yet powerful APIs to manage crypto, card issuing and banking in Europe.**

<https://youtu.be/XK3p-gO1sCM>

**Who we are**

Prashanth founded Striga in 2018 to build a better payments network utilizing Bitcoin, having experienced first hand the pains of gaining access to banking as an immigrant in Europe for moving funds across borders. As he got the company got off the ground with it’s initial consumer facing Bitcoin Lightning powered neo-bank in Europe (Lastbit) and shipping the world’s first ever non-custodial instant payments device, building Striga was inevitable, with growing friction between financial institutions and crypto first companies.

Today, Striga powers the core infrastructure for numerous European crypto companies which would have otherwise simply not existed with the barrier to entry being raised year over year.

Through the recession of 2022 and the downfall of large names in crypto, Striga’s small but mighty team successfully weathered the storm, secured a VASP license, built banking relationships, issuing relationships and mainly the core platform [that is public today](https://portal.striga.com/signup).

**The deal**

Embed card issuing into your product using Striga and your first 500 physical cards are on us, free of charge!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70901&key=user_uploads/590685/0d1bd91f-c7a6-44b5-9573-eb52721d8d00)

launches.title: Striga - Crypto and Banking APIs
launches.tagline: Embed crypto & banking infrastructure into your application
launches.body:
Hello YC,

Prashanth here, from Striga. Striga is a set of APIs that allows you to blend **banking infrastructure and crypto infrastructure** **in a way** **that works for your application**, without requiring you to need a license or compliance team of any sort.

For instance, you can issue a Visa card and link it to a USDT or Bitcoin account, or you can simply onboard users and generate unique USDC deposit addresses to build compliant on/off ramps.\
\
Check out the documentation here - [docs.striga.com](https://docs.striga.com/)

### **What Striga Fixes**

Building and launching a crypto application that uses traditional financial services (such as card issuing/banking) is either compliance intensive, expensive, constrained or unavailable.

We shipped the first ever Bitcoin LN powered payment card which took nearly 2.5 years to come to fruition, simply because banks refused to work with us or give us the room we needed to innovate. Instead, we ended up having to build two separate mobile applications powered by two different banks, connected via the lightning network. Those same APIs evolved into what Striga is today.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64541&key=user_uploads/590685/29cffa6d-39b1-4665-af3c-f2b7e0bf67d5)

If you are building a payments application or anything that requires on/off ramps or secure crypto custody/trading, I encourage you to try building on Striga - We’ve seen prototypes built in less than 24 hours! 

[You can sign up for a free developer account](https://portal.striga.com/), get your API keys, fork our postman collection and start building in minutes!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64541&key=user_uploads/590685/81e1b1b4-89d1-46df-a36e-81e875f87aa9)


### **The deal**

Pricing for launching your app on Striga is [publicly available here](https://striga.com/pricing). Please contact us on [hello@striga.com](mailto:hello@striga.com) if you're interested in building on the platform!

Additionally, if you're looking to launch payment cards and saw this post, get in touch and we'll give you a **50% discount on the manufacturing cost of your first batch of cards** with us (i.e. **500 free physical cards**).

name: ZOKO
long_description:
Zoko: The Ultimate WhatsApp Commerce Solution for Shopify Merchants

WHY ZOKO IS THE GAME-CHANGING PLATFORM EVERY SHOPIFY MERCHANT NEEDS
Shopify merchants face a critical challenge: while they've built amazing online stores, they're missing out on the world's largest messaging platform where customers actually want to shop. Zoko solves this by seamlessly integrating WhatsApp commerce capabilities with your existing Shopify infrastructure.

THE UNTAPPED OPPORTUNITY THAT'S COSTING YOU SALES
Consider this: 175 million people message businesses on WhatsApp daily - that's more engagement than Amazon generates. With 100 million merchants already using WhatsApp for business globally, those not leveraging this channel are falling behind competitors who are capturing sales directly through conversations.

PROVEN SUCCESS FORMULA
Zoko's founders didn't just theorize about WhatsApp commerce - they lived it. Starting with their own ecommerce business entirely on WhatsApp, they scaled to 200,000 engaged followers who eagerly purchased products through weekly WhatsApp updates. When other businesses began paying for access to their "WhatsApp sales tools," they knew they'd discovered something revolutionary.

THE $50 BILLION MARKET OPPORTUNITY
The WhatsApp commerce market represents over $50 billion annually - a massive revenue stream that traditional ecommerce platforms can't access. For Shopify merchants, this means untapped customers, higher engagement rates, and sales happening through the world's most trusted messaging platform.

COMPLETE SALES, MARKETING & SUPPORT INTEGRATION
Zoko transforms WhatsApp into a comprehensive business channel, enabling Shopify merchants to:
- Convert conversations directly into sales
- Run targeted marketing campaigns through WhatsApp
- Provide instant customer support where customers prefer to communicate
- Build deeper customer relationships through personalized messaging

THE FUTURE OF COMMERCE IS CONVERSATIONAL
WhatsApp represents the internet for the next billion users entering the digital economy. Zoko positions itself as the "Shopify for WhatsApp merchants," giving existing Shopify store owners the tools to dominate this emerging channel before competitors realize its potential.

For Shopify merchants serious about growth, Zoko isn't just another tool - it's the bridge to the next generation of ecommerce where conversations convert to sales.
one_liner: Better Business on WhatsApp

launches.title: 🧠  Zoko: Unleash AI inside your WhatsApp Business number
launches.tagline: A legion of untiring sales agents, powered by ChatGPT
launches.body:
Hi YC! This is [Aromal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/251201) and [Arjun](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/198845), the founders of ZOKO.

Zoko (https://www.zoko.io/) now lets ecommerce merchants add a fully-functioning sales agent to their WhatsApp Business number in a few minutes.

**Here’s a video of how it works**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zj6zNXdH8Tc

**Who is it for** 
We are building this for the 200M monthly active businesses on WhatsApp. Most business today, use WhatsApp as fancy SMS - i.e. for sending out marketing blasts. They don’t have a way to scale sales inside WhatsApp.

**Our Backstory**
🤔 We started off with an ecommerce business, entirely on WhatsApp, which grew to a customer base of 200K followers on Facebook, who would make purchases after seeing our weekly product drops on WhatsApp.
Other businesses started reaching out to us, offering to pay for our "WhatsApp sales tools". That was the Aha moment! We realized that selling these tools to other businesses, was the way to go and launched a SaaS business. Through the good grace of a lot of people helping us along the way - we got paying customers, investors, even YC and making millions in revenue profitably! yay!

**Wanna play with it?**
Sure! Open this link in WhatsApp https://wa.me/c/918849966041 (If you have WhatsApp Pay add the 1 INR product and make a real payment to get the full experience)

We are very open to feedback and have thick skins. Feel free to reach out to any of us with feedback, questions, etc. Email [founders@zoko.io](mailto:founders@zoko.io) or whatsapp me directly [wa.me/919108281134](http://wa.me/919108281134)

**Ask**
Thanks for reading about us. **_We are looking to connect with ecommerce brands in WhatsApp dominated markets - India, Middle East, Western Europe and South America._** If you are one or know of brands that would love to scale-up sales on WhatsApp, please get in touch with us at [founders@zoko.io](mailto:founders@zoko.io), thanks :)

launches.title: 🧠 Codeball – AI Code Review
launches.tagline: Codeball approves Pull Requests that a human would have approved. Wait less for review, save time and money.
launches.body:
Hey fellow builders!

I'd like to show you something we recently built at Sturdy (W21).

[**Codeball**](https://codeball.ai/) **is a code review AI which approves safe Pull Requests that a human would have approved.** We _hate_ waiting for reviews.

This started off as scratching our own itch in answering "How predictable are programmers?" Very predictable, turned out to be the answer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64214&key=user_uploads/586182/2a1fd4ab-7a26-4a54-a9cd-a7ccc394aaed)

## **🧠 How**

Codeball is trained on over 1M Pull Requests, so it has seen tons of failure (shitty code) and success (decent code) patterns, making it really good at telling the difference.

You can play with it at [codeball.ai](https://codeball.ai) where you can do "historical" tests on GitHub repos to see what Codeball would have done.

Using AI for mundane reviews saves a bunch of time, but the part that's really cool is that once you stop rubber stamping every single PR, you pay more attention to the tricky ones.

## **👉 Getting started**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64214&key=user_uploads/586182/956431aa-6b25-45dc-b343-fb9905cced54)

You can add Codeball to your repository as a [GitHub Action](https://github.com/sturdy-dev/codeball-action/) (takes like 2 minutes).

_Try for free!_

## **💻 What are developers saying?**

Codeball is currently used by over 100 open-source repositories, including HUGE communities like gogs, kratos, and emqx!

“This is incredible, don’t forget to charge us!” – CEO

“I love it, developers are now trying to ‘cheat’ the system by creating smaller PRs, just like I’ve been telling them to!” – Senior Software Engineer

Also a bunch more in the [Hacker News thread](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31533180) that made front page recently.

long_description:
Infracost shifts cloud costs left and makes FinOps proactive. It sits in the engineering workflow (CI/CD), and shows the cost impact of code changes (IaC) before the code is shipped to production. This catches costly mistakes before any money has been spent. It also checks to make sure all resources are tagged with your set tagging policy, and runs checks on the code against our FinOps policy packs, ensuring best practices are followed (e.g. using Graviton processors and storage lifecycle rules).

This creates a cost-aware engineering culture.
one_liner: Shift FinOps Left: Proactively Find & Fix Cloud Cost Issues

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: In our first startup, we built one of the first cloud cost management products, which was later acquired and is now part of the Flexera One product. That was back in 2012. The cloud cost management space hasn’t changed in 10 years. Every company still starts from the bills, meaning they look for issues and react. With Infracost, we wanted to apply the shift left philisophy, which worked great is security to cloud costs. That’s what Infracost has become - we [Shift FinOps Left](https://www.infracost.io/) into the engineering workflow.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: We applied to YC back in 2012. Back then there was 10,000 prices from AWS. Since then, [cloud costs have become very complex](https://www.infracost.io/blog/why-are-cloud-costs-so-complex/), and we now track nearly 4 million prices from AWS, Azure and GCP. YC was fantastic back then (we interviewed with PG), and it was even better when we got accepted into the W21 batch!

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: Our YC group keeps a monthly check-in going. It has been great to meetup on Zoom once a month to talk about any main issues, questions, learnings that any of the companies have had.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Every single cloud cost management product out there is reactive in nature. Infracost is the only FinOps product that is designed with engineers in mind, making it easy for them to ship code fast, and keep within FinOps best practices before they merge their code. Things like:* Ensuring the right [cloud tags](https://www.infracost.io/docs/infracost_cloud/tagging_policies/) are set* Ensuring [FinOps best practices](https://www.infracost.io/docs/infracost_cloud/finops_policies/) are followed* [Budgets](https://www.infracost.io/docs/infracost_cloud/guardrails/) are checked before money has been spent* Data is integrated into Jira with our [FinOps for Jira](https://www.infracost.io/docs/infracost_cloud/jira_integration/) appAll within the engineering workflow (directly in a GitHub PR, or GitLab MR).

Prior to Infracost, Ali co-founded two cloud startups that were acquired. launches.title: Kitemaker - Build better software. Together.
launches.tagline: Everything you need to organize the product development process
launches.body:
_**TL;DR:** Kitemaker is a tool that allows you to keep specifications, user feedback, roadmaps, and tasks in one place, providing a better workflow than any collection of product management, documentation, and issue-tracking tools. Is it fast? Yes. Is it simple and easy to use? Absolutely. In addition, it works very well to facilitate collaboration between engineering, design, and product management._

Hey!

We're Kevin and Sigurd, the co-founders of [Kitemaker](https://kitemaker.co/). We built Kitemaker because we felt that the tools we used for project management, collecting feedback, and writing specifications were disconnected. This resulted in engineers, designers, and product managers working in separate silos, making it harder to focus on what truly matters: building things that users want.

# **The problem**

Most YC companies have taken the wisdom of [Michael Seibels' "Product Development Cycles"](https://www.ycombinator.com/library/4e-guide-to-product-development) to heart. To reach product-market fit, we need to talk to customers, figure out what they want, build, launch, and then iterate. There are plenty of good tools to collect user feedback, write specification documents, and track tasks/issues.

However, it's all disjointed. It’s easy to drop the ball on user feedback, which isn’t connected to the tool where we’re writing specs, which again isn’t connected to our issue tracker. It's easy to become disorganized or spend too much time project managing when we should be spending as much time as possible talking to users and iterating on the product and the messaging.

# **Our solution -** Kitemaker

Kitemaker allows you to keep specifications, tasks, roadmaps, and user feedback in one place. We have carefully designed it to provide a better workflow than any collection of product management, documentation, and issue-tracking tools.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76035&key=user_uploads/394001/e6a52980-d8ce-450d-9e10-a956b9fe3884)

# **How it works**

The basic unit in Kitemaker is the work item. It has a document where you can write your specifications and break them into tasks, as well as an activity feed for discussions and to see what is happening across the development tools. We encourage you not to split work items into many small pieces but rather use to-dos to keep track of the tasks. This way, you will be able to focus on what you plan to deliver to your users, rather than individual tasks. Additionally, you will have all the to-dos in the same place as your discussions and specifications, meaning there will be one place to see everything relevant to a new feature or a bug fix.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76035&key=user_uploads/394001/b736cb07-b7ca-4c58-adee-c43de4ae3fde)

When you receive user feedback, we have a section where you can organize all of it. You can either write the feedback directly in Kitemaker, or you can use our Intercom or Zapier integrations (with more integrations to come). You can select any part of the feedback, capture it as an insight, and link it directly to work items. Since the insights and feedback will be directly linked to the work items, you and your team will know exactly what was said and by whom on the work item screen.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76035&key=user_uploads/394001/227b02d1-81c1-44a7-8ba1-7696c42f9183)

There are many more features and integrations for you to explore, so if you are curious, feel free to check out our [website](https://kitemaker.co/).

# What our users love about Kitemaker

* It's fast, easy to use, and simple to get started with.
* Work items let you have specs, tasks, and discussions in the same place, making it easy for engineering, design, and product management to collaborate in the same tool.
* Having user feedback directly connected to the stuff you are working on is incredibly powerful, and the Intercom integration directly syncs conversations into Kitemaker.
* Our to-dos have everything engineers expect for issues, like git automation, referencing, and metadata, so the hierarchy fits perfectly for teams that focus on shipping awesome stuff to users.

# Asks

We love all kinds of feedback, so if you are curious about Kitemaker, head over to [https://www.kitemaker.co](https://kitemaker.co/) and give us some feedback when you have tried it.

You can also join our [community here](https://join.slack.com/t/kitemakerco/shared_invite/zt-e7zjicw1-zbBpvLSRfOFKh3DutUAJ0A), where you can discuss Kitemaker or all things product development.

We’re also super interested in chatting with people about their product development process. Both to learn how you approach it or just give you some insights into what we have seen talking to many 100s of teams.

launches.title: Galaxy 🕹️ - Social multiplayer for games
launches.tagline: Add clans & community to any game in under an hour.
launches.body:
**The Problem:** Mobile games are fun for a while, but players get bored quickly (especially when it’s singleplayer)

**The Solution:** Competing with friends makes games way more interesting

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70127&key=user_uploads/263116/31b26d16-89c8-4088-80a4-8d47611a6919)

Galaxy is a free SDK that adds **community** to any single or multiplayer game (in less than an hour). 

* _Clans_: Players can create, join, and recruit teams. They compete against other teams and can chat with the group.
* _Real Friends_: Players can sync their contacts and easily see/interact with their friends on leaderboards.
* _Avatars_: Demonstrating the authenticity of opponents amplifies the feeling of winning. It also provides an optional revenue stream to games who want to sell cosmetics.
* _Powerful Leaderboards:_ Configure & manage leaderboards from a dashboard. Set up automatic prizes, repeating tournaments, ban users, customize UI, and more.

Players love it. Session length increases by \~1m55s and D7 retention rises by as much as 37%. Additionally, teams encourage players to invite their friends who don’t already play the game - leading to free user growth as well. Here’s a graph from one of our customers after they added Clan leaderboards:  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70127&key=user_uploads/263116/a21e9395-7c8f-4bdd-b6bf-48c1949b33a9)

But what about implementation? We’ve worked hard to make it as simple as possible to implement. Here’s the steps:

1. Call ReportScore()
2. Call ShowLeaderboard()

That’s it! The UI is customizable, localized and works on mobile or web.

We’re already working with 115 games and serving over 250,000 end users. You can [sign up](https://galaxysdk.com) for free or [book a call](https://calendly.com/adambn/galaxy-sdk) if you’re interested.

In the room, the AI Scribe turns the conversation into structured notes, the AI Interpreter handles live language in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, and more, and RejoyGPT plus clinical decision support answer questions while the patient is still there. After the visit, the AI Coder suggests ICD-10 and CPT codes so billing goes out cleaner and faster. A medical search engine and study companion sit in the same suite for guidelines, journals, and exam prep.

Not another chatbot. One system for doctors, nurses, MAs, and the front desk. More accurate than ChatGPT. HIPAA-compliant. Trusted by 40,000+ clinicians at leading US hospitals and health systems.

You stay in charge. Rejoy does the work. Book more patients. See more patients. Chart less.

name: REGENT
long_description:
REGENT is building a new mode of transportation that will redefine regional mobility by 2026. Their first product, the seaglider, is an all-electric, hydrofoiling flying-boat that operates within a wingspan of the water's surface.  By flying low on a cushion of air, seagliders unlock the ability to fly twice as far as an electric aircraft, while being regulated by maritime authorities enabling market entry for a fraction of the cost.
 
REGENT has de-risked seaglider technology with a ¼-scale flying demonstration vehicle. By this summer, REGENT will fly humans on the 15,000 lb (7000kg) first full-scale prototype seaglider, which will be the largest electric-flying machine in history.

By late 2026, REGENT’s customers - airlines and ferry companies – will begin commercial seaglider service on the 12-seat initial product.  A 100 passenger version, already with firm orders, will follow several years later.

In just four years, REGENT has accumulated >$10B in pre-orders (including firm deposits) from airlines and ferry companies around the world.  Currently a team of 100, REGENT is led by MIT-trained, ex-Boeing engineers Billy Thalheimer and Mike Klinker.  REGENT has raised over $100M to date from the likes of Founders Fund, Japan Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines and Lockheed Martin, and is on contract with the US Marine Corps.
one_liner: All-electric seagliders for fast, affordable regional transportation

**TLDR:** [Rethoric](https://www.rethoric.com/) is a data-driven thought leadership content creation as a service that amplifies the personal brands of busy founders with personalized content on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Newsletters to build credibility, attract funding, and acquire customers on autopilot.

### **📖 The Context:**

Founder-led marketing is one of the most effective and high-converting acquisition strategies for startups.

**That is why many founders are investing time and resources in building their personal brand**

* **Garry Tan** knows the importance of personal branding, so much so that he went in and created his own YouTube channel. [**https://www.youtube.com/c/garrytan**](https://www.youtube.com/c/garrytan)
* **Ankur Nagpal**, founder of Teachable (acquired by Hotmart), uses his personal brand as the main acquisition strategy for his current startup, Carry. [**https://twitter.com/ankurnagpal**](https://twitter.com/ankurnagpal)
* **Rahul Vohra**, founder of Superhuman, leverages X to talk to customers and maintain his authority in the email space. [**https://twitter.com/rahulvohra**](https://twitter.com/rahulvohra)
* **Dharmesh Shah**, co-founder and CTO of Hubspot, posts almost daily on LinkedIn and X and has achieved a massive Thought Leadership authority in the tech space. [**https://twitter.com/dharmesh**](https://twitter.com/dharmesh)

And the list goes on…

### **😩 The Problem:**

* Founders are extremely busy and don’t have the time or energy to create content daily because they are swamped working on their startups.
* Founders don’t know how to implement an effective organic content strategy
* Traditional marketing methods like branding or paid ads don’t work how they used to and end up in unsustainable CACs

[**Rethoric**](https://rethoric.com/) is not an AI tool that writes content for you. **World-class human writers and editors create all the content** with your own voice based on your insights, lessons, experiences, and stories, which we extract on interview calls.

**How it works:**

* Step 1: **Join an Interview Call Twice a Month,** during which we extract your expertise into optimized social-media-ready content.
* Step 2: **Approve Twice a Month** - We send you 2-week content batches for review with unlimited revisions.
* Step 3: **Engage Online** - We coach you to reply and start engaging in conversations in your comments.

### **🤩 Benefits of Investing in Your Personal Brand as a Founder**

**Save Time**

Just a 45-minute call and a quick 15-minute content review every two weeks, and 5-10 minutes per day to reply and engage in the comments. We handle the rest, letting your personal brand flourish while you focus on what you do best.

**Fundraise Easier**

Position yourself as an industry authority. Our content showcases your thought leadership, attracting investors eager to support visionaries with proven insights and innovation track record.

**Attract Top-Level Hires**

When your personal brand shines, so does your appeal to high-caliber talent. They'll be lining up to work with you, drawn by the promise of being part of a visionary-led future.

**Build Credibility and Status**

As your stories and insights circulate, your status as an industry leader solidifies. Building a brand isn't just about being seen; it's about being recognized as the go-to expert in your field.

**Reduce Your Acquisition Costs**

With every post, tweet, and update, you're not just reaching an audience but building a community that lowers your overall acquisition costs as your organic reach grows.

**See tangible ROI**

Where the magic happens, the engagement, followers, and leads all translate into an organic sales funnel with a quantifiable impact on your startup's growth and valuation.

### **📈 Traction**

25k MRR, 0% churn, launched 4 months ago.

### **🤝 The Team**

Edu has founded 4 startups with 2 successful exits, bringing deep expertise in consumer and B2B SaaS and web3 space and an extensive network within the startup ecosystem.

Lev combines a rare mix of software engineer, copywriter, and ghostwriter skills with high proficiency in coding and crafting compelling narratives.

name: Dressd
long_description:
Dressd is AirBnb for clothes; a P2P clothing rental marketplace. Unlike Rent the Runway, we don’t handle any inventory or deal with cleaning the items. Our initial target market is sorority girls who can have up to 3-4 events per week that they need a new outfit/dress for. One of our core theses is that this idea couldn’t have existed at scale until now because resale apps like Depop & Poshmark paved the way for a P2P model to work after familiarizing users with the process of taking pictures of items, shipping, etc. 

Advantages to our P2P model

- Entrepreneur-led
    - Similar to Depop, most of our growth will be spearheaded by a group of “top renters”
- More variety in inventory
    - Existing rental companies like Rent the Runway own all the inventory so they're limited to the brands they buy/partner with. Since we're P2P, our users can rent any item or brand that's in someone else's closet
- Better margins
    - we don’t touch any inventory or deal with the cleaning of any items
    - Unlike Rent the Runway, we don’t handle any inventory or the cleaning of items. This means people renting out their clothing on Dressd are responsible for shipping things out & returning them in good condition

Here are some of our links!

launches.tagline: Minty transforms text into video from stock images.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** 🚀 We’re launching [**Minty**](https://minty.so)—a tool that transforms any text into video content from stock images, making it easier for creators and businesses to reach diverse audiences. We’d love your feedback!

### **Our Ask:**

🙌 Check out [**Minty**](https://minty.so), try it out, and share your thoughts. Your feedback will help us shape the future of this tool. You can try it by inputting a blog article you want a video for.

### **❌ The Problem:**

In our journey with **Axolo**, we realized that repurposing content into various formats—blogs, presentations, videos—can be time-consuming and complex. With different audiences preferring different content formats, there’s a missed opportunity to fully engage with them.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfTYVGk1XGW73RMz0mTQA-DnnstfH2oiCv82Rn3qCqHGaJyKMy_EKzcLc-Lqzq1emfmhtc6SzblJADvj1OnVg4mkcszgGRL_hPrww4NQo3abgcMC9KNf-9GPXvp-GwbStge2zUxwr39MGnKpyFmIAaL3hoV?key=8obgDvzbHJEp-qJnYH2WgQ)

### **The Solution:**

✨ **Minty** makes creating videos from text with just three simple steps:

1. **Form:** 📝 Enter your text, choose a music track, set the tone, pick a social media, and select a voice-over.
2. **Storyboard:** 🎨 Minty creates an outline of what will be said that you can edit like a Powerpoint presentation, allowing you to edit the voice-over of your video.
3. **Video Editing:** 🎬 We transform the storyboard into a fully edited video, complete with stock image, voice-over, and subtitles. You can customize it further with your own footage or choose from our stock library.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcVmdB62NGETD3HIqpeToFMDD74ByjaljxahKDzMDZgj1Xchy-FVkkyjdpi48t50DDtNiAmbqPD7usQD-NVOuWT2gVZk8483ONYSvyGu-gOAe1NHkhMGQu-JtQ-M2JPpAPURSt-5y2bTd7M0NA0LT-dpe0?key=8obgDvzbHJEp-qJnYH2WgQ)


Minty takes the complexity out of video creation, enabling you to focus on delivering your message in a format that resonates with your audience.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdApxWGYHI-EKGabzZAt4L4deEjepUzni_STsvkqhsKj_gdnTv9lVo91fTjL6zkeCLb_N4Gqrue8hC8zFNGejxmxdwKYN0tS615Ma2zvb82f9go7ymk3OT4e7mhHEDnwdACbPcJtqmDKCE158VGZL7nexup?key=8obgDvzbHJEp-qJnYH2WgQ)

launches.title: Axolo: Merge code faster 🐙 now on GitLab (and GitHub)
launches.tagline: Review merge requests faster
launches.body:
On top of GitHub Axolo is now also available on GitLab. Now every team who is on Slack and GitLab or GitHub can collaborate seamlessly on code reviews.

**🤯 Problem:**

Why pay engineers 100 thousand dollars to have them sit and wait for their code to be reviewed? Code review workflow is, more often than not, unproductive.

\
We’ve identified three major problems:

1. Time to review: Takes too long to be reviewed and it’s painful.
2. Context switching: Switching between code review tools and Slack to communicate is a time waster.
3. Documentation: It’s hard to document everything that is being said. Merge requests are being talked about in DM and private calls. There is no documentation, and it’s hard to know why a decision was made.

**🎯Developers lose precious focus time**

We estimate that developers waste at least 2 hours per week coordinating with one another on pull requests.

For a team of 20 that represents the work of 1 developer full-time. This is at least 140k$ per year.

**🏚 In-house solutions and bots are going OBSOLETE.**

1. Noizy - Alerts everyone and then gets ignored
2. Hard to maintain
3. Miss critical info: deployments, GitHub Actions, and checks.

**\
🐙 Introducing Axolo: we bring back focus to your developers:**

Companies using Axolo have seen a 40% decrease in average cycle time. 86% of developers who use Axolo on a daily basis say that it has improved their code review workflow.\
\
**How does it work?**

It’s simple: Axolo creates an ephemeral Slack channel for each code review, invites only the right people, and adds all contextual information needed (CI/CD, ticket link, code conflicts, code review comments, etc..). When the code is merged the channel gets archived silently.

\
Still Sceptical? Check our [reviews on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/axolo).

We have already more than 1400 engineers on Axolo every day and are proud to be working with excellent YC companies such as [@Weekday](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/22719), [@Formance (fka Numary)](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/24379), [@Lamin Labs](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/27092), [@Curebase](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1884), [@Swayable](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1878), [@Jovian](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/24205), [@Swayable](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1878), [@Marble](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/24497), [@Centaur Labs](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/11948), [@Fuse](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/12073), [@ClipDrop](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/22752), and more…

**Ask YC**

Communication and collaboration are one of the five pillars of highly effective tech teams (according to the [SPACE framework](https://axolo.co/blog/p/developer-productivity)).\
\
If you are looking to have productive code reviews, and have squads composed of 3-15 engineers, we are interested in getting your feedback on Axolo. Just reach out within the chat on <https://axolo.co> and we’ll be around!

launches.title: Axolo 🐙  GitHub-Slack two-way synchronization
launches.tagline: Enable your team to merge pull requests faster
launches.body:
**Problem?** GitHub pull request workflow is unproductive

1. Time to review: Dangling pull requests are waste of time and a source of frustration for developers. They cause the code development process to slow down and prevent developers from focusing on a new task ahead.  Engineers need to write DM + @channels to get the attention their work needs.
2. Context switching: Between GitHub, Slack, video calls, and their product management software, engineers are piling up their mental load with so many tools and notifications.
3. Documentation: Pull requests are being talked about in DM and private calls. There is no documentation, and it’s hard to know why a decision was made.

\
**Solution?** Axolo centralizes pull requests in contextual Slack channels

1. 1 PR = 1 Slack channel. Only invites reviewers and creators.
2. Get personalized and friendly reminders about stale pull requests.
3. The conversation is saved on GitHub.
4. The Slack channel is auto-archive when the PR is merged and you can also auto-leave PR channels after approval.

name: Recover
long_description:
Recover provides more effective and affordable addiction treatment via telemedicine. We partner with local governments to save lives and taxpayer dollars.

More than 20 million Americans struggle with addiction, but less than 10% of people who need it receive treatment. For those that do, it usually does not work - only 8% get better. Most of this treatment is funded by governments, and goes to programs that are frequently predatory, and focus more on profit than people.

We have created an effective, accessible, and affordable solution: Recover. We offer a proven approach using medication and counseling, that can improve outcomes for over 70% of patients. It reduces overdoses by 80%, death by 50%, and has years of research and application showing it works. 

Despite how effective this medication can be, most rehabs do not have medical professionals on staff. Not only does our program work better and bring medicine to addiction care, it also costs just 10% of traditional programs.

Nick founded Recover after seeing his family and friends struggle with addiction. He was raised by a drug addict, has an alcoholic brother, and lost an uncle to heroin. He saw how hard it is for people to get the treatment they need, and how ineffective existing options are. We are working to make sure that people like Nick’s family have access to best-in-class addiction treatment so they can get and stay well.
one_liner: Government-funded online addiction treatment

launches.title: Jiga: The White Box Manufacturing Platform 🦾
launches.tagline: Source high-quality, cost-competitive custom parts faster by partnering directly with vetted manufacturers
launches.body:
# **What is Jiga?**

Jiga is a sourcing platform that enables engineers to get quick quotes and place orders with manufacturing suppliers, maintaining full transparency and direct communication to the manufacturer who actually make the parts.

We are proud to help the best engineering teams in the world bring their products quickly from idea to production, including blue-chip accounts such as Tesla, NASA, Apple, KLA, Siemens, and others.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86643&key=user_uploads/371504/9cf849f6-bf2d-49a5-b221-c7917443aae7)


# **Why We Built Jiga?**

Mechanical engineers often face challenges when sourcing custom parts, such as managing messy email threads and maintaining spreadsheets of quotes and quote requests.

These inefficiencies often lead to miscommunication, delays, and increased costs, making the procurement process time-consuming and frustrating for both sides.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86643&key=user_uploads/371504/07a793ad-c2e1-44a7-8dc8-e526f2c001e6)


On the other hand, many digital manufacturing services provide instant quotes but completely hide the manufacturer from the engineers, making it very hard to collaborate on complex parts. Imagine you are an engineer that spent weeks on designing a part on your 3D software, you need to talk to the machinist and explain them the small nuances in your design. Otherwise, they will get it completely wrong and valuable time and money will be wasted.

We call it "The Black Box Problem".

# **Our Solution**

Jiga platform offers a transparent way to connects engineers directly with vetted suppliers, **facilitating** efficient collaboration and communication.

By eliminating the middleman, we reduce support expenses, enhance scalability by empowering suppliers to manage support, and create strong network effects through collaborative workflows.

We use AI under the hood to automate all the manual tasks that engineers (and no one else, really) want to do: matching the right suppliers, monitoring production processes, finding and reporting discrepancies, extracting data from engineering and procurement documents, following up, mitigating delays, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86643&key=user_uploads/371504/351fb1a7-cd48-4be2-b6cb-8e78c4edf995)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86643&key=user_uploads/371504/8f6b2e32-00fb-47a5-82fb-7a3c3d3c735a)

# **How to Get Started?**

If you are ready to ditch the black box:

* Sign up: <https://jiga.io>
* Talk to us: [founders@jiga.io](mailto:founders@jiga.io)
* Follow our engineering content on LinkedIn: <https://www.linkedin.com/company/jiga3d/>

launches.title: 🐝 Wasp Beta - Develop full-stack web apps in React & Node.js without boilerplate
launches.tagline: Get auth, CRUD, async workers and other common features via Wasp config language and write the rest of your logic in React, Node.js and Prisma
launches.body:
Hey developers! 👋 We’re Martin and Matija, founders of Wasp - we’re super excited to be here today!

Our last big launch was one and a half years ago - since then a lot happened and **we’re proud to present Wasp Beta!**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/0ed916ef-e2e5-4cd4-8241-f9702617e45e)

### **⚡️TL;DR**

**Wasp is the fastest way to develop full-stack web apps in React & Node.js**. Describe high-level features (auth, CRUD, async jobs, …) via a simple config language, and write the rest of your logic in React, Node.js and Prisma.

With the Beta release, we also [**announced our first hackathon**](https://betathon.wasp-lang.dev/) - make sure to join, have fun, and win cool prizes! (hint: wasp-themed mechanical keyboard 🐝 ⌨️)

You can see the 4-min demo video [here](https://youtu.be/eVXbctXquK4).

### **🐝 🐝 The team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/49bc358b-14d3-4385-b593-f1b175a0795a)

This is us at our first retreat in Croatia (Vince, our devrel, who joined shortly after, expertly photoshopped in :D)!\
We’re a distributed team of engineers and web development & programming language aficionados. Having worked at some of the world’s largest companies and startups, we experienced the problem we’re solving at various stages.

### 💡 **What is Wasp?**

**You can think of Wasp as a full-stack web framework for React & Node.js**. We solve the common problems you face when you start developing a web app - choosing all the parts of the stack, figuring out how to stitch them together in the best way, adding auth, running cron jobs, ...

Wasp also makes it super easy to work with and sync data models across the entire stack (front-end, back-end, database). You don't even have to define and deal with any kind of CRUD API - Wasp will do that for you under the hood.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/7e32a672-dec6-4f31-9fa7-1c9c35de2545)

### 🦉 **Who is it for?**

Speaking to developers we realized many of them just want to build, and they’ll use whichever tool helps them best achieve their goals. They don’t care that the library being used for making HTTP requests is 2kb bigger and builds 10ms slower than some new alternative. They just want to be sure they have all the best practices in place and that their choices won't come back to haunt them once their project grows.

If you can relate to that, then Wasp is for you. We know there are plenty of great solutions for developers today (frameworks, BaaS-es, code scaffolders, ...) but Wasp is probably the fastest one to get started with, and with the least amount of code.

### 🍜 **What's the secret sauce?**

The main reason for that is Wasp's unique twist on web frameworks - a config language (DSL) that works alongside your React & Node.js code. It allowed us to **drastically reduce the amount of boilerplate and simplify the developer experience**. For example, full-stack authentication with both user/pass and Google methods takes only 8 lines of code.

In the future, the language approach could enable us to do some really exciting things such as supporting multiple frameworks and languages (even at the same time) and having full control over the generated code, introducing optimizations, etc.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/d712d053-1786-4d31-af06-cc773c00444f)

Wasp now has its own language server - that means auto-completion, live error reporting, …

🏘 **What can I build with Wasp?**

Pretty much any web app with a database! Anything you'd build with React & Node.js by themselves you can build with Wasp. Think SaaS, side projects, internal tools, hackathons, ...

To see what others are building with Wasp, take a look here: [Wasp showcase gallery](https://wasp-lang.dev/#showcases)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/8cf380fa-522b-470a-bbf9-95b3f0201034)

With the intro out of the way, let's see what's new in Beta:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=67668&key=user_uploads/109403/702a317f-f8e9-446e-b8f1-46f59e95cb5d)

🔑 **Full-stack auth**\
Log in with your username & password or via Google! Other providers are also coming soon.

🟦 **TypeScript support** \
Write your code in TypeScript, both on the client and server! We're also migrating our whole codebase and adding new types every day.

💨 **Tailwind support**\
Just add two config files and you are ready to use Tailwind in your project!

⏳ **Running Async Jobs**\

name: Forcyte Biotechnologies
long_description:
In a nutshell: many diseases are caused by how much your cells squeeze (asthma, fibrosis, others). We discover drugs that control how much cells squeeze, with ease, to treat disease.

We use patented bioMEMS technology to turn cell strength (cells' ability to pull/ squeeze) into a quantifiable metric in drug discovery, to help find better drugs for mechanical diseases. 

We screen 100,000s of drugs against numerous contractile human cell types to comprehensively map human mechanobiology (the "contractome") and identify promising drug development starting points to deliver novel medicines to treat mechanically-driven diseases including asthma, hypertension, preterm labor, fibrosis, and others.
one_liner: Discover drugs that control how much cells "squeeze" to treat disease

Over the last 10 years, Dr. Di Carlo co-founded seven startup companies in life science research tools, diagnostics, medical device, and pharmaceutical industries.

long_description: Waydev maps AI velocity across the SDLC — built on DORA, SPACE, and DX — turning developer tool data into board-ready evidence of adoption, impact, and ROI.
one_liner: Engineering intelligence for AI transformation

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: I started my entrepreneurial journey early, building my first company in Romania at 21. Over the next decade I launched multiple products and learned how hard it is for engineering teams to explain the value they create. The idea for Waydev came from firsthand frustration while trying to understand developer output beyond gut feelings and subjective dashboards. There was no clear way to measure engineering performance using system data, so I decided to build it myself.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: I applied to YC because I believed Waydev could become a category defining product and I wanted to sharpen our execution with the best early stage accelerator in the world. It wasn’t an easy path. I applied 13 times before being accepted, and each rejection forced me to refine the idea, tighten the pitch, and improve the product. When we finally joined YC, the experience was transformative. The batch pushed us to move faster, simplify our messaging, and talk to customers every day. Demo Day helped us raise capital and accelerate our trajectory. More importantly, YC gave us a mindset of relentless iteration that still defines how we operate.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: YC has remained a core part of our company. I’m active in Bookface, talking to other founders about growth, engineering metrics, and the future of AI driven development. Many of our customers and partners come through YC referrals. We share learnings with other B2B and infra founders, and we rely on YC’s internal forums, templates, and tools for fundraising, hiring, and pricing decisions. YC helped us get started, but the community is what continues to compound our progress.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Waydev started as a simple tool to analyze Git activity. The product evolved quickly as customers pushed us toward deeper insights and enterprise scale. Key moments included securing our first Fortune 500 customers, launching integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, and building out enterprise features like SSO, RBAC, and advanced reporting.

A major inflection point came when we recognized that engineering intelligence needed an AI native interface. This led to the launch of Waydev AI, our conversational layer that lets leaders ask questions and get insights instantly without dashboards. Today, we support both large enterprises and fast growing teams, and we continue to integrate AI deeply into how engineering work is analyzed and measured.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Engineering is the most expensive function in modern companies, but historically it has been the hardest to measure. Leaders rely on anecdotal feedback, siloed dashboards, or lagging indicators that fail to capture the full picture of productivity, quality, and delivery. This lack of visibility leads to poor decisions, misalignment, reactive planning, and inefficient budgets.

We solve this by giving teams a unified intelligence layer that turns system data into clear, actionable insights. The problem is huge because every company depends on software, and engineering performance directly affects speed, cost, and competitiveness. I decided to work on this because I experienced the pain myself as a founder and saw thousands of teams navigating the same challenge.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long term vision is to build the intelligence engine behind every engineering organization. If we succeed, companies will understand their engineering health as clearly as they understand revenue or churn. Leaders will make better decisions, teams will work in a more predictable and balanced way, and engineering will become a transparent, measurable, and optimized function. In the future we imagine, every company will be able to ask one question, “What is happening in engineering and what should we do next?” and Waydev will deliver the answer instantly.

In 2017 I launched Waydev, defining the Software Engineering Intelligence category — bootstrapped to profitability, recognized by Gartner and G2, and trusted by Fortune 500 teams at American Express, Caterpillar, Dropbox, and PwC.
